Theorem
[Weak Harnack inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0397, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0398 1. ch26:26.47\group Weak Heat Solutions

Assume the local $L^2$ Poincare inequality (26.124) and the local volume doubling condition (26.125). Then there are $p_0>0$ and $A<\infty $ such that every positive weak heat supersolution satisfies \[ \left(\frac1{\Vol (Q'_-)}\int _{Q'_-}u^{p_0}\, d\mu dt\right)^{1/p_0} \le A\inf _{Q_+}u \] on the parabolic subregions specified in the source.
